decisions.reason: The glazed industrial sectional door is part of the firm's core industrial door range, and the investment in tooling and certification was substantial, so management sees no reason to write it off while it was still shown publicly in 2019.

The insulated glazed variant matches the firm's announced push into thermal and regulatory-compliant solutions, so it is tied to the stated strategic direction and sunk development costs, and any weak results can be blamed on temporary market conditions.
Giving this door a dedicated page was a visible public commitment, so dropping it would expose the earlier launch decision as a mistake and write off a clear investment.
